Subject: Acme PoC — Architecture deep-dive and migration checklist

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme is interested in moving forward with a short PoC to validate migration from our current provider (OldInference) to Redwood. Our engineering and SRE teams want a technical deep-dive to review the current architecture, identify potential gaps (network, KV cache, quantized model compatibility), and agree on a migration checklist.

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute architecture review the week of Apr 26? Suggested attendees from our side: myself (Dir. AI), Kate Brown (Procurement, copied), and James Lee from OldInference who can walk through the existing setup. Please let me know a few slots that work on your side and whether Redwood will include a solutions engineer and someone from infra.

Thanks,
Alex

Director of AI Engineering
Acme Corp

Availability (PT):
- Tue 2027-04-27: 11:00–12:30
- Wed 2027-04-28: 09:00–10:30
- Thu 2027-04-29: 14:00–15:30

Attendees from our side: me (sales), Dev Patel (solutions engineer), Priyom Das (platform lead). Lauren is looped for exec alignment.

I've attached a short agenda and a network prerequisites checklist to help your infra team prepare (acme-redwood-poc-agenda.pdf, network-prereqs.xlsx). Can you confirm which slot works and whether James will share a topology diagram ahead of time? Also please flag any compliance/security reviewers who should attend.

Thanks,
